Tokyo to Lake Kawaguchi with a big suitcase?
Bus or train? Here's how we'd choose 👇

🗺️ Full guide 👉 https://japanbystation.com/tokyo-to-kawaguchiko-big-suitcase-bus-or-train

🚌 Option A: the highway bus
💴 ¥2,000, and your case rides free in the hold.
🧳 One large suitcase per person.
You never lift it onto a rack.
📍 It leaves from Busta Shinjuku, 4th floor.
That's 2 minutes from JR Shinjuku's New South Gate.
🕕 Buses run from 6:45 to 22:25.
🚦 About 1 hour 45 minutes, but traffic can slow it.
No changes or refunds after departure.

🚆 Option B: the Fuji Excursion train
💴 ¥4,200, direct, with no traffic risk.
⏰ December weekdays from Shinjuku:
7:30, 8:30, 9:30 and 10:30.
🎫 Every seat is reserved.
Tickets go on sale a month ahead.
Weekends often sell out.

🔁 Option C: change at Otsuki
🚉 Take the Kaiji from Shinjuku, about an hour.
Then a Fujikyu local train (¥1,170).
🌙 Last weekday link: the 21:59 Kaiji.
It meets the 23:10 last train.

✅ Our take
Weekday, one case each? Take the bus.
Weekend, holiday or a booked tour?
Take the train. It can't get stuck in traffic.
Two big cases each? Train too.
The bus takes only one per person.

👉 Every time, plus a trick for sold-out trains:
